name: dual-axis-guard
title: Dual Axis Guard
description: Stops a dual-axis chart from showing a correlation that isn't there by catching zero baselines at different heights and independent ranges that make a +15% line and a +140% line climb in lockstep, saying how much each series really changed, and offering a one-tap "index both to 100" that puts them on one honest scale (with your own chart library through a render prop, or the built-in SVG).
